description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1743/23 of 02.02.2012 and others
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific modifications to land parcel records, including servitude rights, extent amendments, and expungement of particulars for various land parcels in the Colombo District. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, specifically title registration amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
